article.title: 更進新聞：Brandlight推出ChatGPT商品型錄匯出與代理指示工具
article.summary: Brandlight公布兩項配置工具，協助企業準備ChatGPT品牌代理指示及商品資料。
highlights: 可從現有Brandlight Commerce型錄匯出ChatGPT商品資料格式。
指示由Brandlight資料輔助生成，企業仍需確認OpenAI的商家及代理資格。
article.why: 電商和客服團隊可把商品資料的準確性與品牌代理回答規則分開驗收。
article.next_step: 抽查一批商品的庫存和售價，再讓客服主管審閱退貨和轉介指示。
article.detail: Brandlight表示，新工具可根據其平台資料生成ChatGPT品牌代理指示，並把客戶現有Brandlight Commerce型錄轉為ChatGPT商品資料格式。企業可先按地區確認商家和代理開放資格，再核對匯出欄位及客服回答規則。Brandlight指出，認領商家頁面也無法保證得到更多獨立推薦。
article.title_en: Update: Brandlight adds ChatGPT catalogue export and agent instruction tools
article.summary_en: Brandlight announced tools to prepare instructions for ChatGPT Business Agents and format product data.
highlights_en: Existing Brandlight Commerce catalogues can be exported in ChatGPT's product feed format.
Instructions draw on Brandlight data. Companies still need to check OpenAI's eligibility rules.
article.why_en: Commerce and service teams can validate product data and the agent's response rules separately.
article.next_step_en: Check a sample of product stock and prices, then have support leads review return and escalation instructions.
article.detail_en: Brandlight says the tools draft ChatGPT Business Agent instructions from its platform data and convert existing Brandlight Commerce catalogues into ChatGPT's feed format. Confirm market and agent eligibility before validating feed fields and support responses. Brandlight says claiming a profile does not guarantee higher visibility in independent recommendations.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
article.followup: 11月13日版報道OpenAI商家中心。本次是第三方Brandlight新增型錄及指示工具。
article.followup_en: The November 13 edition covered OpenAI's Business Hub. This update covers Brandlight's third-party preparation tools.
